scientific_integrity: The proof relies on analytic finite-state lattice Edgeworth expansion; 97 finite checks cannot certify the infinite theorem. Previously known independent-binomial case explicitly excluded.
scientific_limitations: Fixed, strictly positive two-state kernel with nonzero lag-one correlation; one-dimensional variance-normalized occupation count; no uniform boundary assertion, no independent historical priority review.
title: Sharp Gaussian quadratic transport and skewness cancellation for a stationary binary Markov chain
